name: Gakin the Darkbinder
summary: Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder teaches the warlock arts in secret. He tests aspiring Alliance warlocks before they attempt to summon and bind demons.

sections.title: A Secret Gathering Place
sections.body: Below The Slaughtered Lamb's taproom, a cellar shelters those who study shadow and fel. The crypt-like room holds summoning circles and grim tomes, hidden from the eyes that watch Stormwind's open mage sanctuaries. Gakin guides young warlocks there, teaching discipline and restraint before they summon forces they cannot control.

sections.title: Master of Demons
sections.body: Gakin teaches demonology and the rites used to bind demons. Those who earn his notice travel across the kingdom to gather rare things, including stolen bloodstone talismans and corrupt wood from dark forests. When the materials are ready, Gakin oversees their work in the crypt's summoning circle. Novices must master voidwalkers and succubi in trials that test their will and put their lives at risk.

sections.title: Betrayals and Loose Ends
sections.body: Surena Caledon, a former apprentice of Gakin, fled into the wilds with a valuable Bloodstone Choker. Her betrayal could expose the warlock circle to Stormwind's guards. Gakin sends loyal followers to recover lost artifacts and silence loose ends before the authorities take notice.

faq.q: Where can I find Gakin the Darkbinder?
faq.answer: Gakin waits beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Enter the tavern and take the downward ramp at the back. Follow the stone tunnels to the summoning circle in the lowest crypt.

faq.q: What does Gakin the Darkbinder do?
faq.answer: Gakin mentors Alliance warlocks and tests novices with trials across Azeroth. He teaches them to summon and bind demons such as the Voidwalker and Succubus.

faq.q: Why are warlocks allowed under The Slaughtered Lamb?
faq.answer: Stormwind forbids demonic magic and deeply mistrusts it. The warlocks beneath The Slaughtered Lamb work in secrecy, hidden from guards and citizens and tolerated as a dangerous covert asset.
Surena Caledon was Gakin's former student, and she stole a powerful Bloodstone Choker from him. Her betrayal threatens the hidden order, so Gakin sends warlocks to track her down.

faq.q: Which demons does Gakin help summon?
faq.answer: Gakin oversees rites to bind Voidwalkers and Succubi. He guides warlocks as they summon the demons into the underground circle and subdue them.

faq.q: Who is Strahad and why does Gakin mention him?
aliases: where does gakin send me next
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is an experienced warlock in the Ratchet hills of Kalimdor. After a student masters Gakin's basic binding rites, Gakin sends them across the sea to continue their dark studies with Strahad.

angles.text: As a human or gnome warlock, you can learn the rites to summon and bind a voidwalker and succubus from Gakin in Stormwind's crypts.
Gakin's hidden circle beneath the capital reveals the compromises made in the heart of the Alliance.
